summary: Safe Bulkers, Inc. furnished a Form 6-K on October 2, 2026, announcing its board declared regular quarterly cash dividends of $0.50 per share on each of its 8.00% Series C and Series D Cumulative Redeemable Perpetual Preferred Shares, covering the period from July 30 to October 29, 2026. Payable October 30, 2026, to holders of record October 16, 2026. This is a routine preferred dividend declaration, not a special situation; no deal terms, advisors, or structural mechanics beyond standard quarterly arrears payment. Watch for ordinary cash-flow and covenant coverage trends.
